description: Payload of a <<<TOOL_CALL>>> envelope emitted by Imagine. The host validates this payload against this schema before any execution. Every envelope is terminated by <<<END>>>. Unknown tools and malformed arguments are rejected by the host and never executed.

arguments.description: Arguments for the named tool. Conforms to the per-tool subschema selected by 'name'. All unknown keys are rejected (additionalProperties: false in every branch).

oneOf.description: Takes no arguments. Returns the current time from the host clock in the configured timezone.
oneOf.title: clock.now arguments

sql.description: A single SELECT statement to analyze. No other statement types are permitted.

max_rows.description: Hard cap on rows returned to the model. Must be positive and at most 1000.

sql.description: A single bounded SELECT statement to run. Non-SELECT statements are rejected by the host.

key.description: Row key (primary or _id value) whose provenance record is requested.

table.description: Table whose provenance record is requested.

name.description: Registry tool to invoke. Must be one of the v1 read-only tools.

title: Imagine tool_call envelope payload
